latest_final: The story is a wordplay puzzle. The apparent situation—a University of Hong Kong student needing to select academic courses before a deadline, then finding all courses gone in one evening—is misdirection. "Courses" here means the courses of a meal, not classes. The student ate all the food courses served over the course of that evening, so "all my courses were gone" simply means all the dishes had been eaten. The academic framing is a deliberate pun to make the disappearance sound like a university scheduling disaster.
